scope: BOM-grounded dimensions for separate Blender presentation controls and connector faces; actual KiCad boards and 425 native model instances untouched.

soft_touch_knob.source_kind: Manufacturer dimension drawing EPD-200220, revised 2008-07-23; public university mirror visually inspected
limitations: Nominal dimensions only. Pointer outline, small radii, bore depth and D-flat geometry may be simplified in a separate presentation model.
13.2 mm is the circular rubber body diameter; the 0.8 mm pointer protrusion extends outside the body. Current Mouser product metadata rounds overall diameter/height to14/16 mm.
Original BOM links EPD-200219, which describes450-XX18 T18-shaft knobs; use EPD-200220 because it explicitly lists450-4760 with 6.0 mm D-shaft.
Height above panel and shaft insertion are not established by the parts list or knob drawing. Full knob height must be retained even when part extends below the panel.

rotary_knob.source_kind: Manufacturer product catalog table for 1510AH, current web retrieval
limitations: Manufacturer table dimensions are0.75 in diameter,0.56 in height and0.25 in plain molded shaft hole. Values converted with25.4 mm/in.
Catalog height is rounded to0.56 in; another distributor description gives9/16 in. Use14.224 mm for traceability to the primary table rather than claiming an exact historical molded-part tolerance.
Shape detailing, knob seating height and angular pointer position remain a presentation interpretation. No manufacturer CAD downloaded.

switch_cap.manufacturer_part: PE/WHT and PE/BLK (current PE WH and PE BK)
switch_cap.source_kind: Manufacturer PVA and PN cap drawings; PE rectangular cap callouts
limitations: BOM specifies8 white and15 black caps but gives no per-reference color map. Color placement requires an original assembly photograph/manual; a sorted first-eight assignment is a presentation choice.
Published11 mm cap height includes the hidden portion. Height above the panel and mounting to the actual TL1100/B3F footprint must remain illustrative.

The extracted PDF also has a13.7 mm callout with inconsistent inch conversion(.59); it is not used as the cap outer height. PrimaryPE length/width/height are independently corroborated by current distributor part records.
Concave top and internal snap-fit socket are not fully specified for parametric replication. No manufacturer CAD retrieved.
Current C&K PVA compatibility documentation is not proof of a verified fit on the historical E-Switch TL1100F160Q switch or actual B3F-40XX board footprint.

toggle_lever.source_kind: Manufacturer B-series drawing and ordering table, pagesA14-A15
limitations: Original BOM referenceSW1 corresponds to actual scene S1.
26 degrees is the manufacturer nominal angle-of-throw callout; use the state orientation only as a visual pose.
The round10 mm lever is nickel plated brass. B12AB has an unthreaded polymer bushing; no mounting nut or washer is established by this BOM.
Installed bushing height relative to panel and exact historical package variant remain unverified. No nativeCAD downloaded.

audio_jack_hardware.source_kind: Manufacturer NYS216 mechanical drawing dated 2015-05-27, visually inspected localPDF/PNG
limitations: Separate exterior hardware illustration only. Existing actual PCB and native models remain unchanged.
Manufacturer drawing givesPA6+30%GF black nut andABS black washer, not chromed metal hardware.
Nut scallops, thread form and surface detail may be simplified; nut overall17.5 mm envelope should be preserved.
The current official drawing does not establish exact historical terminal sections and source pad asymmetries. This exterior illustration does not qualify a full PCB componentCAD model.
Axial seating order and projection above the original rear panel are scene assumptions unless independently resolved.

mini_audio_jack_face.source_kind: Official Same Sky MJ-3536N mechanical drawing 2024-09-12, page2, visually inspected localPDF
limitations: Current manufacturer drawing is a close family reference to historical MJ-CP3536N; historical assembly tolerances and installed panel depth remain unverified.
Current MJ-3536N has documented 2023/2024 reengineering. Do not treat exterior dimensions as proof of exact original connector-body/lead identity.
Bushing material is nickel plated brass; black housing isPBT. No guessed mounting nut is established by this drawing.

power_jack_face.source_kind: Official Same Sky PJ-202AH mechanical drawing 2025-07-24, page2, visually inspected localPDF
limitations: BOM describes2.1 mm barrel input; current manufacturerPJ-202AH drawing specifies2.0 mm pin. Use source drawing 2.0 mm for visible pin and record the terminology difference.
Face rectangle and aperture supported; panel projection, small molded details and body seating remain presentation assumptions.
This exterior supplement is not a new full thickness qualified PCB model.

din_jack_face.source_kind: Official Same Sky SDS-J mechanical drawing dated 2024-09-12, page 3 SDS-50J lower drawing, visually inspected local PDF
limitations: Original BOM identifies SDS-50J and distributor CP-2350; actual footprint name CP-2350 is an order code, not a different proven geometry.
The current 2024/2025 manufacturer drawing and PCN show reengineering. Its full body and leads are not qualified as an exact historical component model.
Body face rectangle is 20x21.1mm and sits behind the panel. Circular mating recess outer diameter is not dimensioned; retain original panel cutout and label any added round face an approximation.
Diameter 19 mm denotes the mounting circle of three 1.6 mm mounting holes, not the circular mating recess outer diameter.
Five contacts occupy a 180 degree arc on 7 mm pitch circle. Contact cavity outline, hole diameters and insertion depth remain illustrative.
The flange is 1.8 mm thick; mounting position relative to rear panel remains an explicit scene assumption.
Original BOM permits any USB Type B through-hole jack. Actual board footprint PN61729 does not prove Kobiconn part identity.
No manufacturer drawing downloaded for this increment. Supplemental face geometry remains a presentation proxy sized against exact original DXF cutout.

identity_mismatches.impact: Do not substitute a CTS body or claim verified mounting fit from the originalBOM. Eagle450-4760 exterior knob is independently specified by BOM.
Cap identity and exterior dimensions do not qualify native tact-switch body/lead geometry.
Only generic USB Type B identity supported for separate face proxy.
